blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—Human rights group Karapatan criticized the University of Santo Tomas (UST) for suspending four student activists who staged a campus protest against the Philippine Air Force (PAF), calling the action a violation of their rights to free expression and peaceful assembly. The students—Raven Racelis, Ralph Manuel, Mecaella Capallar, and Dex Frogoso—were suspended for four to 10 days over the April 21 protest. Capala was also removed from her post as a student council officer, while the university withheld the students’ certificates of good moral character. “We stand with the UST students in their struggle against this latest act of repression […]...
